lines.en: Would you like to respond to this message?
What would you like to say?
: {i}I don't think you're legally allowed to send me nudes of other people without their consent.{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Should I refrain from doing this in the future?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No. I'm looking forward to the continuation of this series.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不。我很期待这个系列的续集。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yesssss. More pictures of the wild Fukuyama in all of its buxom glory.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好好好好。多来点野生 Fukuyama 波涛汹涌的倩影。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you jerking off right now?{/i}
: {i}Nope. Just admiring the view.{/i}
: {i}Lame.{/i}
: {i}Maybe if you got a little closer when you took the picture.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你拍照的时候要是再凑近点就好了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I will remember that in the future ;D{/i}
: {i}There is one glaring problem with this image.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这张照片有一个非常明显的问题。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh? Do tell.{/i}
: {i}Why do you have a towel on?{/i}
: {i}Because I had already finished my shower, Sensei.{/i}
: {i}It wouldn't be appropriate for me to just traipse around in the nude.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就这么一丝不挂地到处晃悠，不太合适吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But it was appropriate to take a nude picture of Futaba without her consent?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那未经 Futaba 同意就给她拍裸照就合适了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, wow. I didn't even realize she was in the picture.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦哇。我都没注意到她在画面里。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I was just trying to take a cute selfie.{/i}
: {i}You'd be cuter without clothes on.{/i}
: {i}Oh yeah? ;D{/i}
: {i}I'll keep that in mind for my next selfie.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我拍下一张自拍的时候会记住的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Excellent research photo, Nodoka.{/i}
: {i}I camped out nine hours for this shot.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为了这一张，我蹲点了九个小时。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You camped out in the shower for nine hours?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在浴室里蹲点了九个小时？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I really like showers.{/i}
: {i}I also really like breasts.{/i}
: {i}I regret nothing.{/i}
: {i}Do you have any more?{/i}
: {i}Not at the moment. But I'm currently waiting outside of her normal camping grounds for the chance to take another.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}暂时没有。不过我正守在她常出没的营地外头，等着机会再拍一张。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I shall keep you in the loop.{/i}
: {i}Oh shit! Gotta go!{/i}
: {i}The Fukuyama approaches!{/i}
